company: Transform Formwork Contractors Group Pty Ltd
title: Designer / Draftsperson
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a draftsperson?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have experience using AutoCAD 2D?
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK (advert 95191525); no link out and no applications email published by the employer.
rationale: Both essentials are met: AutoCAD proficiency (Advanced Diploma drawings prepared and reviewed in AutoCAD and Civil 3D) and a current White Card.

Duties to review drawings for accuracy, update them to site conditions and coordinate with site teams match Marc's site work reviewing structural and architectural drawings against the work in 2019 to 2020.
Site-based construction drafting role suits a candidate with both design study and site experience.
caution: Formwork design experience is highly regarded and Marc has none. His drafting is from study, not a paid drafting role, so the years-as-draftsperson question must be answered as none. Sydney site-based role means relocation from Melton. Transform Formwork appeared once before on the tracker (Site Engineer Formwork, contact unverified, 10 Sep 2026); no application to it is recorded.
employer_line: Transform Formwork, founded in 2011 in Wetherill Park, delivers formwork, steel fixing and concreting packages for residential, commercial, parking and warehouse structures across Sydney, including formwork for Wee Hur at 90 Regent Street, Redfern.
